finding_key: packages/backend/src/document/document.controller.ts::the pr's headline behavior — list `updatedat`/ordering now sourced from postgres, editors from the best-effort yorkie call — has no test at all
evidence: document.controller.ts:56-70 rewrites attachMeta (updatedAt from the DB column, editors from getEditors) and lines 116/148 switch to the orderBy array, yet the only supplied controller spec (document.controller.spec.ts) tests createDocument fileId gating and still stubs the admin service as `{ getSummaries: jest.fn() }` (line 13), never invoking attachMeta; the three new specs added by the PR all cover the webhook ingest side. The e2e authenticated-http.e2e-spec.ts does call GET /documents but asserts only `body[0].id`, so nothing asserts updatedAt's source, order stability when the Yorkie call fails, or editor attachment — the claim is slightly overstated in saying "no test at all" touches the path. I could not read packages/backend/test/http.e2e-spec.ts (not supplied, and no checkout is mounted), which the reviewer also skipped and which is the repo's mocked-service controller contract suite, so a partial assertion there cannot be ruled out. Impact is a test-coverage gap only, not a behavioral defect.
